newsitem.title: USA: Philip Morris downplays Florida ruling.
newsitem.headline: Philip Morris downplays Florida ruling.

text.p: Philip Morris Cos Inc said Thursday a decision by the Florida Supreme Court not to review the class certification of the Engle vs. Philip Morris case is not a decision on the merits of the case.

The company said the propriety of the class certification may still be reviewed at a later time by the Florida Supreme Court. "In the meantime, we will be considering whether to ask the U.S. Supreme Court to review the decision," the company said in a statement released in response to the Wednesday decision.
The company said the decision was procedural and left the case where it was before the cigarette companies sought discretionary review.
"Philip Morris believes the Engle case is without legal and factual merit, and the plaintiffs still face several substantial legal hurdles before they can get to trial," the company said.

Charles Wall, senior vice president and deputy general counsel for Philip Morris, said in the statement, "It's crucial to recognize that, if this case ever does go to trial, a final resolution will require hundreds of thousands of individual trials."
